uncertainFacts: Exact Credit costs are guide-reported and should be rechecked in-game when direct capture is available.
Bastion tier placement differs between sources, so public copy avoids a definitive tier-list promise.
Necromancer is listed at 250,000 Credits in current May 2026 guide sources; older references may show different values.
Class portraits are local 220x220 crops from row-specific Pro Game Guides class images. Replace with direct in-game class cards/icons if those become available.

items.name: Survivor
items.bestFor: Learning lane control before spending Credits on a class unlock.
items.soloTeamNote: Usable as the free baseline, but it falls behind stronger damage, healing, and structure classes.
items.unlockPriority: Free starter; replace with Medic or Marksman once Credits allow.
items.verificationNote: Roster, rarity, and kit cross-checked against Pro Game Guides and GamesToUse. Cost is free in all checked class summaries.

items.name: Medic
items.bestFor: Public squads, structure-heavy teams, and players who want the cheapest strong support unlock.
items.soloTeamNote: Best in co-op because healing players and structures keeps a defensive lane alive longer.
items.unlockPriority: Best cheap support unlock; buy early if your squad needs sustain.
items.verificationNote: Cost from SurviveZombieArena.com and GamesToUse. Kit and support role cross-checked with Pro Game Guides and Destructoid.

items.name: Marksman
items.bestFor: Solo players or small groups that need direct weapon damage before expensive classes.
items.soloTeamNote: Strong first damage unlock, but it needs movement and positioning because it does not bring healing or barricades.
items.unlockPriority: Best early damage unlock; a practical first buy after Survivor.
items.verificationNote: Cost from SurviveZombieArena.com and GamesToUse. Kit and damage role cross-checked with Pro Game Guides and Roonby.

items.name: Engineer
items.kitSummary: Flame Turret; Auto Turret; Steel Barricade
items.bestFor: Holding a chokepoint with automated damage before Tactician is affordable.
items.soloTeamNote: Works better with a Medic or teammates because structures need protection as waves scale.
items.unlockPriority: Useful structure step, but Tactician is the stronger long-term defense path.
items.verificationNote: Cost from SurviveZombieArena.com and GamesToUse. Kit and scaling caveat cross-checked with Pro Game Guides.

items.name: Ninja
items.bestFor: Short escape windows, clutch movement, and players who specifically want the stealth kit.
items.soloTeamNote: Risky in later waves because the class wants closer range than most safer damage options.
items.unlockPriority: Low priority for progression; skip unless you want the stealth playstyle.
items.verificationNote: Cost from SurviveZombieArena.com and GamesToUse. Kit and close-range risk cross-checked with Pro Game Guides and Roonby.

items.name: Demolitionist
items.bestFor: Stalling and punishing packed zombie groups while teammates reposition.
items.soloTeamNote: Useful for AoE pressure, but less consistent than classes that bring stronger lane control or team sustain.
items.unlockPriority: Mid-cost specialty pick; buy when pack control is the problem you need to solve.
items.verificationNote: Cost from SurviveZombieArena.com and GamesToUse. Kit and AoE role cross-checked with Pro Game Guides and Roonby.

items.name: Tactician
items.bestFor: Team holds, chokepoints, and defensive setups that need structures to target tougher enemies.
items.soloTeamNote: Pairs especially well with Medic because healing support keeps structures alive through heavy waves.
items.unlockPriority: Strong mid-progression defense goal after early Credit unlocks.
items.verificationNote: Cost from SurviveZombieArena.com and GamesToUse. Vanguard Turret behavior and Medic pairing cross-checked with Pro Game Guides and Destructoid.

items.name: Bastion
items.bestFor: Team survival, defensive holds, and squads that want a shelter-style tool during wave spikes.
items.soloTeamNote: Strongest when the team can hold around Bunker and let automated support keep pressure off the group.
items.unlockPriority: Late goal for squad-focused players; compare against Necromancer before saving 200,000 Credits.
items.verificationNote: Cost from SurviveZombieArena.com and GamesToUse. Kit from Pro Game Guides. Tier placement differs between sources, so no public tier field is used.

items.name: Necromancer
items.kitSummary: Soul Harvester; Raise Undead; Death Nova
items.bestFor: Late-wave pushes where dense zombie waves feed the soul, minion, and detonation loop.
items.soloTeamNote: Works in solo or teams, but it needs active timing so Death Nova does not erase your own frontline too early.
items.unlockPriority: Most expensive long-term damage goal; save for it after early class and weapon needs are stable.
items.verificationNote: Cost from current May 2026 guide sources. Kit and late-wave loop cross-checked with Pro Game Guides, Games.GG, Roonby, and Destructoid.
